scripts.test: pnpm --filter domain test && pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.lint: oxlint apps/web/src apps/web/tests apps/api/src apps/api/scripts apps/api/tests packages/domain/src packages/domain/tests
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix apps/web/src apps/web/tests apps/api/src apps/api/scripts apps/api/tests packages/domain/src packages/domain/tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter domain typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter web exec tsc -b
scripts.build: pnpm --filter domain build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.precommit: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
